Commentary.Commentary: England bowlers did well only in patches to pick up wickets as their economy rate was not that impressive. All their three pacers got 2 wickets each. Rashid was the pick of the bowlers with his 10-0-36-0 figures although he failed to get any wicket. Can Sri Lanka defend this? Or we will see this run chase as a stroll in a park for the hosts. Do join us for in a while to find out.

The Islanders once again got the momentum when Prasanna and Mathews worked out a 68-run stand with Prasanna playing a flashy innings with his quickfire fifty. Towards the end, they lost a lot of wickets and that really affected the run rate. Maharoof and Shanaka did well to get the score past 280.

What a comeback by the hosts! Sri lankans were off to a decent start with that two short and crisp partnerships at the beginning. But the real architects of this innings were Chandimal and Mathews in the middle overs, they stitched 64 together before the former got out.

On the other hand, Sri Lanka who had a bad Test series showed some improvement towards the third Test. They have defeated Ireland 2-0 before heading to this series and have showed that they are a better side when it comes to the ODI format. They have ticked all their boxes with such a brilliant overall performance. Nevertheless, it promises to be a great game of cricket as these two teams have powerhouse players in their unit. Stay tuned for the all important toss.

Hello and a warm welcome for England and Sri Lanka 5-match ODI series which shall start today at Trent Bridge. After a great Test series, the hosts will look to dominate once again and get the series under their belt straightaway as they are leading with 10-2 points. The Englishmen are riding high as all their batsmen, especially Root and Roy are key for them. In the bowling department, the pacers will like to outclass the opponents.
